message.description: What the notification says, in one short sentence. It is required, and a blank string does not count.

title.description: Says what the message is about. Without one, the notification shows Notification.

variant.description: How the notification looks, by what happened. It does not change how long the notification stays.

duration.description: How long the notification stays, in milliseconds. 0 keeps it until it is dismissed or removed. Must be finite, not negative, and at most 2147483647. Changing it replaces the notification with a new one.

action.description: One button in the notification, such as Undo, that runs its handler once and closes the notification. With an action, a duration other than 0 lasts at least 10000 ms.

dismiss.description: Reports the notification being dismissed, by a person or a timeout, at most once. An unmount does not call it.

members.name: label
members.description: The button's text and accessible name, in a word or two, such as Undo. It is required, and a blank string does not count.

members.name: onAction
members.description: Runs once when the button is activated, before the toast closes and onDismiss reports the dismissal.

ToastAction.description: A toast's one action, such as Undo: a button with its own name and handler.
